title: Birth in the old Quarter, parents and brother
summary: Purnell gives his birth date and address, his father's drumming, his saxophonist brother, and the move to a Black neighborhood around age nine or ten.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So it's going. My name is Alton Ponyo. I was born 726 St. Peter Street, right down in old Korea.
I was born April 16, 1911. I'm 47 right now. I didn't hear much music around that time.
Did your parents play any music?
My daddy played a little drums, but not with any bands to mount anything. And of course my mother was just a housewife.
How many brothers and sisters? A little bit about your family?

I have one brother who is now a saxophone player. His name is Théodore Ponyo. I think he's been a little sick. But the last report I got from him that he was coming along real nicely. And I said we lived around this neighborhood until I imagine around 9, 10 years of age. And then my mother moved out of the old career. We moved into, which was more of a colored section. And that's where I began to pick up on his jazz music.
